verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Pulley supports uploading an Excel cap-table template as the source of truth for initial cap table setup, implying bulk upload of historical stakeholder/security data (pulley-docs-1, pulley-docs-2), but there is no explicit documentation of an ops workflow for issuing a *new batch* of grants at once (e.g., bulk option grant issuance) versus one at a time. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-grant issuance feature docs, UI/API support for batch grant creation beyond initial import, and independent/hands-on corroboration.
